lanes.summary: Bevel sends notifications (v3.2.7 adds a preview when a Bevel Intelligence reply is ready), but where a tap lands, and what happens signed out, was not observed or documented.

Health asks are explained first and optional ("This can later be readjusted in Settings"); a missing-data screen tells people to enable sharing in Settings/Health, but there is no direct Settings link and the in-app fix steps go through the Health app.
steps: "Allow access to Health" > Connect to Health
"Go to Settings and enable ... in Health"

lanes.summary: Paywalls seen ("Upgrade to Bevel Pro", "Start Free for 7 days", "No payment due now") plus a credits store; the StoreKit sheet, cancel, Ask to Buy/pending and failure handling were not observed.
sources: Mobbin flow f561e1bb-3568-4289-a908-ae6d0235a030 (Subscribing to Bevel Pro)

lanes.summary: Docs promise a gentle downgrade: Pro until period end, then a Free tier with "the full Bevel tracking experience", all history kept, and 60 days to resubscribe at the old price; billing-retry grace messaging in the app was not observed.
sources: https://help.bevel.health/en/articles/11583937 (Membership & Pricing): "All of your historical data, logs, and trends stay in your account"; "60-day grace period if you cancel"

lanes.summary: Account-based: Sign in with Apple or an email magic link restores the account, Settings has "Restore data from backend", and Bevel staff point to "Restore Purchase" on the payment screen (one report of it failing with Family Sharing).
sources: Mobbin screen 0e858159-918d-4901-96cd-d0c12d56ed5d (Settings: Restore data from backend)
https://feedback.bevel.health/feature-requests/p/family-sharing-support (report: Restore Purchase reply, Family Sharing failures)

lanes.summary: In-app Account details > "Delete account" with one alert ("All data pertaining to your account will be deleted. This action cannot be undone."); the signed-out end state and any note about cancelling the Apple subscription were not observed.
Help center says "Most of Bevel's core features work without an internet connection"; food logging, barcode scanning and Bevel Intelligence need internet. No offline banner or state was observed.

After an update Bevel can show a full-screen "Access the latest updates" asking for more Health permissions; that is a permission gate, not a What's New, and release notes live only in the App Store (e.g. 3.2.7 calendar sync).
steps: "need more permissions to your Health data"

lanes.summary: Limits are stated before they bite: Settings shows "Weekly limits 5% used, Limit resets…" and extra credits, which can be bought at the limit. A failed food match explains itself ("Food items not found" with "Go to food log"). Whether a typed chat message survives an AI failure is unverified.
sources: Mobbin flow 5fb47042-e2e8-4bd7-95d7-2ec4a257c8bc (Bevel Intelligence: Weekly limits, Extra credits)
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6456176249 (credits at limit; fix for chats stuck thinking)

lanes.summary: Withdrawing is one switch: Settings > Customization > Bevel Intelligence has a "Bevel Intelligence" toggle, and when off the usage section disappears. Docs say LLM providers don't train on the data. No consent screen was seen before first use (chat opens "Hi Alex, welcome to Bevel Intelligence!"), and a re-ask after turning it off is unverified.
sources: Mobbin flow 5f74184d-a9a5-47e6-8692-35116e19bf7c (Chatting with Bevel AI, onboarding chat)
https://help.bevel.health/en/articles/11586753 ('LLM providers do not use… to train their models')

lanes.summary: Sign-in is "Continue with Apple" or "Use email instead" (email, then a magic link with "Resend Link"). "Log out" in Account details signs out with no confirmation and lands on the welcome, which still offers sign-in. A cancelled Apple sheet, a bad link, and clearing of local Health-derived data weren't observed.

The account plus an "iCloud Sync" row in Settings carry preferences across Apple devices, and the Apple Watch app syncs with the phone. Docs admit sync "can be delayed" and fixes are manual (Resync, clear cache). There's no iPad app and no sharing with other people; one report says Pro fails with Family Sharing.
sources: Mobbin flow 1562d9a8-d6d2-4b4d-91f6-17123aa56796 (Clearing cache & reload all data)

lanes.summary: Most empty states are designed: trackers show "No logs yet / Once you add a log, it will show up here" with add buttons, Today shows "No data" tiles and a "Start cycle tracking" card, and Home shows "Data still catching up". "No Files Yet" explains what goes there but offers no action.
